en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his predecessors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “
Tooba (congratulations) for that face which Allah sees mercifully and that person who is weeping  over  his  sins  in  fear  of  Allah,  the  Mighty  and Sublime and none else is aware of this sin.”
